description: Character and discipline tracking system for draft evaluation. Tracks college discipline events (academic, team rules, substance abuse, conduct, legal) and assigns character grades (exemplary, clean, concern, red_flag) that impact draft position.

discipline_events.note: Random discipline events occur during college years with 2% base chance per player per year. Events are weighted by type and result in games suspended.

types.description: Academic violations: GPA issues, missed classes, academic dishonesty
Team policy violations: curfew, dress code, missed meetings
Substance policy violations: failed drug tests, alcohol violations, PED suspensions
Conduct violations: unsportsmanlike behavior, altercations, code of conduct breaches
Legal issues: arrests, criminal charges, DUI, assault

character_grades.note: Character grades are evaluated at draft time based on complete discipline history. Grades determine draft impact multipliers.

exemplary.description: No discipline issues throughout college career. High character evaluation provides slight draft boost.

clean.description: Single minor incident only. No draft penalty - considered normal college behavior.

concern.description: Multiple minor incidents or single moderate incident. Character concerns result in 5% draft penalty.

red_flag.description: Serious character concerns: legal trouble, multiple major incidents, or pattern of behavior. Draft penalty ranges from 10-30% based on severity.
red_flag.penalty_scaling: Higher severity incidents (legal_trouble, conduct) result in larger penalties within range. Multiple incidents compound the penalty.

interview_red_flags.note: PHASE 2 FEATURE - Currently disabled. Will simulate pre-draft visits and interviews where scouts can detect hidden character concerns.
interview_red_flags.description: When enabled, scouts conduct pre-draft interviews. Higher scout skill increases red flag detection chance. Detected flags amplify character grade penalties.

draft_integration.note: Character grades are evaluated once at draft time and cached in player.character_profile.character_grade. Draft scores are multiplied by character_draft_impact.
draft_integration.description: Character impact multiplies with medical impact: base_score * medical_impact * character_impact. A player with major medical concerns (0.85) and character concerns (0.95) receives combined 0.8075 multiplier (19.25% penalty).

tuning_notes.base_chance_rationale: 2% per year means ~8% of draft class has discipline history (32 out of 400 players). Matches real NFL draft data where 5-10% of prospects have character concerns.
tuning_notes.weight_distribution_rationale: Academic (40%) and team rules (30%) are most common but least impactful. Legal trouble (5%) is rare but creates red flags. Distribution matches NCAA violation statistics.
tuning_notes.grade_distribution_expected: Exemplary: 65%, Clean: 20%, Concern: 12%, Red Flag: 3%. Most players have clean records, serious concerns are rare.
tuning_notes.draft_impact_rationale: Red flag penalties (10-30%) match real draft slides. Examples: Randy Gregory fell 60+ spots due to substance issues, La'el Collins went undrafted due to legal investigation.
